title: gc beads metadata-guarded-clear result
description: Result of a guard-gated sequential metadata clear attempt.

ok.description: True when the guarded clear completed and was classified.

bead_id.description: Exact bead identifier supplied by the caller.

store_ref.description: Canonical exact local store selected for the operation.

guard_key.description: Metadata key that gated every write in the sequence.

outcome.description: Durable classification of the guarded clear attempt. "skipped" means the guard did not match at some point in the sequence, which is an ordinary non-error outcome, not a failure.

keys_written.description: Keys actually written before the sequence stopped, in sorted order.
